name: Motorcycle Simulator Pennsylvania
summary:
Ride Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

24 KM ROUND PHILADELPHIA
Over the Walt Whitman Bridge and down I-76 past the stadiums, north up the Schuylkill Expressway past Grays Ferry, University City and 30th Street Station, east on the Vine Street Expressway under the Center City towers past City Hall, then high over the Delaware on the Ben Franklin Bridge and south through Camden.
